summary: The test budget adapts to the change: mutation testing plans about two mutants per decision point changed (capped by tests.mutation.max_mutants) and none when the change decides nothing; the whole suite runs once instead of twice when CI already runs it on every merge request; between runs only the affected tests run, with the project's affected-tests, per-module coverage and incremental or parallel mutation modes when the repository has them configured, which the repository scout now records. Mutants are always made on a copy, never in the working tree.
